title: Count normalized event names
statement: A service receives a batch of event names. Count occurrences case-insensitively and print names in lowercase lexicographic order with their counts. This synthetic task is unrelated to any resume claim.

contract.stdin: First line: integer n (0 <= n <= 100000). Next n whitespace-separated event-name tokens, each 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-'.
contract.stdout: For each distinct lowercase name in ascending bytewise order, print `<name> <count>` followed by newline. Empty input batch produces no output.
contract.complexity_expectation: O(n log d) time or better, O(d) space, where d is the number of distinct names.
contract.build: Fixed runner image and compiler command; user commands are not accepted.
